title: Lab - Scripting, startup and services
description: Write a script, run it as a service, and make it survive reboots.
scenario: Write a script, run it as a service, and make it survive reboots. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own VM and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# Any Linux VM with sudo will do - Ubuntu 22.04 or Rocky 9, 2 vCPU, 2 GB RAM.
# Snapshot it before you start so a broken task is a revert away.
sudo -i
hostnamectl
cleanup: # Revert the VM snapshot, or undo the changes you made by hand.

tasks.title: Task 1 - Script
tasks.instructions: Write /usr/local/bin/diskreport.sh that appends df -h to /var/log/diskreport.log with a timestamp.

tasks.title: Task 2 - Unit
tasks.instructions: Create diskreport.service running it as a oneshot, then start it.
tasks.solution:
# [Service] Type=oneshot ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/diskreport.sh; [Install] WantedBy=multi-user.target
systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl start diskreport

tasks.title: Task 3 - Target
tasks.instructions: Set the default target to multi-user and confirm without rebooting.
